checklist.step: Refresh the Bermuda ICFR control matrix for the financial year
actions: In AuditBoard open Controls ▸ Frameworks ▸ Bermuda Statutory Reporting and export the prior-year control matrix.
Walk the matrix against the current Insurance Accounts Regulations 1980 statutory forms and the CISSA schedule list; add a control row for any new form line or CISSA input with none.
Record for each control: assertion covered, owner, frequency, evidence artifact and the system it runs in.
Ask the Statutory Reporting Manager to confirm the form-to-control mapping in writing and attach the reply.
Version the refreshed matrix as ICFR-BDA-<year>-v1 and lock prior versions.
checklist.done: the versioned matrix covers every statutory form line and CISSA input with an owner, frequency and evidence artifact.

checklist.step: Map each control to the s.18 records it must produce and retain
actions: For each matrix row, name the record the control produces (reconciliation, journal approval, sign-off) and where it files.
Check the record location satisfies Insurance Act 1978 s.18 — records of the insurance business kept and available at the Bermuda principal office.
Set the retention label on each evidence folder in the compliance evidence repository to the s.18 minimum of 5 years.
Flag any control whose evidence lives only in email and move it into the repository.
checklist.done: every control row names a retained record, filed in the repository with a s.18-compliant retention label.

checklist.step: Operate the monthly close controls over the statutory ledger
actions: In BlackLine open Close Management ▸ Task List for the Bermuda entity and work every task to Complete by workday 5.
Prepare and certify each balance-sheet reconciliation in BlackLine Reconciliations, attaching the sub-ledger extract and clearing items over the USD 25k threshold before certification.
Route journals above the delegated-authority limit to the Controller for approval in the SAP journal workflow.
Export the month's task-completion report and file it under the control's evidence folder.
checklist.done: all close tasks and reconciliations for the month are certified in BlackLine with unreconciled items under threshold.

checklist.step: Reconcile the CISSA data inputs to the statutory ledger
actions: Pull the CISSA input schedules (technical provisions, capital resources, premium and reserve risk exposures) from the actuarial and capital teams.
Tie each input line to the SAP statutory trial balance or the signed valuation workpaper; document each tie-out in the CISSA reconciliation workbook.
Chase the Capital Management Manager for written explanation of any input that moves more than 10% year-on-year.
File the completed workbook and explanations in the compliance evidence repository under CISSA/<year>.
checklist.done: every CISSA input ties to the ledger or a signed workpaper, with >10% movements explained in writing.

checklist.step: Run the quarterly control self-certification
actions: In AuditBoard launch the quarterly certification campaign to every control owner on the Bermuda matrix.
Require each owner to attest operation, attach one evidence instance from the quarter, and declare any failure.
Chase non-responders at day 5 and escalate to the CFO at day 10.
Summarise declared failures with severity and compensating controls for the CFO.
checklist.done: 100% of control owners have certified with evidence attached and failures declared.

checklist.step: Log and remediate control deficiencies
actions: Raise an AuditBoard issue for each declared or discovered failure with the control id, period affected and financial-statement impact.
Assign root cause (design gap, operator lapse, system change, data feed) and a named remediation owner.
Set a remediation date inside the same quarter for key controls; verify closure by re-testing one post-fix instance.
Report open key-control issues to the Audit Committee pack each quarter.
checklist.done: every deficiency has an issue, root cause, owner, date, and a re-tested closure or an Audit Committee disclosure.

checklist.step: Assess ICFR impact of system and process changes
actions: Review the quarter's change calendar from IT and Finance Operations for changes touching the statutory ledger, close tool or CISSA data feeds.
For each change, decide whether an existing control is modified or a new control is needed and update the matrix before go-live.
Obtain the Controller's approval on every matrix change with the change ticket referenced.
Refuse go-live sign-off where the control impact is unassessed.
checklist.done: no in-scope change went live without a matrix impact decision approved by the Controller.

checklist.step: Prepare the CISSA document for the year
actions: Draft the CISSA per the Class 4/3B Prudential Standards Rules 2008 schedule: risk profile, own capital assessment over the planning horizon, stress and scenario results, and comparison to the BSCR.
Source stress parameters from the Enterprise Risk Manager and reserve figures from the Appointed Actuary, both in writing.
Reconcile the CISSA capital figures to the reconciled input workbook from the Statutory Reporting Manager.
Circulate the draft to the CFO and Chief Risk Officer for challenge and log their comments and resolutions.
checklist.done: a complete draft CISSA exists with sourced inputs, documented challenge and figures tied to the reconciliation workbook.

checklist.step: Obtain board approval of the CISSA
actions: Load the CISSA and the challenge log to the board portal pack for the meeting ahead of the filing date.
Table the CISSA for approval; record the discussion, any directed changes and the resolution in the minutes.
Return directed changes to the Capital Management Manager and re-table if the changes are material.
Extract the signed minute evidencing approval and file it with the CISSA in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: a signed board minute approves the filed CISSA version, and both are filed together.

checklist.step: Hand the approved CISSA to Regulatory Reporting for filing
actions: Deliver the board-approved CISSA, the reconciliation workbook and the board minute to the Regulatory Reporting Manager at least 10 business days before the 30 April Capital and Solvency Return deadline.
Confirm the CISSA version hash matches the board-approved version before handover.
Record the handover date and recipient in the filing tracker.
Obtain the BMA e-filing submission confirmation back from Regulatory Reporting and attach it to the CISSA folder.
checklist.done: the approved CISSA is with Regulatory Reporting on time and the filed confirmation is attached to the folder.

checklist.step: Verify the Financial Condition Report publication clock
actions: Per the Insurance (Public Disclosure) Rules 2015, diarise publication of the Financial Condition Report on the company website within 14 days of filing it with the BMA.
Send the approved FCR to the web team with the publication deadline stated and the target URL.
Capture a dated screenshot of the published FCR page and compute filing date + 14 days versus the publication date.
File the screenshot and the day-count in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: the FCR is publicly posted within 14 days of BMA filing, evidenced by a dated capture and day-count.

checklist.step: Maintain the s.18 books-and-records inventory at the principal office
actions: Maintain an inventory of the records of the insurance business required under s.18 and the Insurance Returns and Solvency Regulations 1980, mapped to their repository locations.
Confirm the Bermuda principal office can produce each record class on demand — run one retrieval drill per year and time it.
Apply legal holds from General Counsel before any scheduled disposal.
Report inventory gaps to the Controller with a closure date.
checklist.done: the records inventory is current, a retrieval drill passed this year, and no in-scope record was disposed under hold.

checklist.step: Brief the principal representative on control and capital events
actions: Provide the principal representative a quarterly summary of key-control failures, CISSA status and any event nearing a s.8A reportable-event threshold.
Agree in the briefing note which events, if any, require the principal representative's report to the BMA within 14 days.
Minute the briefing and file it in the compliance evidence repository.
Track any resulting BMA notification to completion in the regulatory filing tracker.
checklist.done: quarterly briefings are minuted and any 14-day notification decision is recorded with its outcome.

checklist.step: Conclude on ICFR effectiveness for the year
actions: Aggregate the four quarterly certifications, the deficiency log and Internal Audit's control test results.
Write the annual ICFR conclusion (effective / effective with deficiencies / ineffective) with the open-issue list appended.
Present the conclusion to the CFO for signature before the statutory filings are approved.
File the signed conclusion in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: a CFO-signed annual ICFR conclusion exists before the statutory return and CISSA are filed.

checklist.step: Retain the year's control and CISSA evidence set
actions: Assemble the year folder: control matrix versions, quarterly certifications, deficiency log, CISSA, reconciliation workbook, board minute and filing confirmation.
Apply the 5-year retention label and the Bermuda/REG-057 index tags.
Verify the folder is retrievable by control id and by CISSA year via the repository search.
Log completion in the compliance calendar.
checklist.done: the complete year folder is labelled, indexed and retrievable in the repository.

testing.step: Build the population of key controls and CISSA inputs for the year
actions: Export from AuditBoard every control on the Bermuda ICFR matrix in force at any point in the financial year, with owner, frequency and evidence link.
Extract the CISSA input schedule list from the filed CISSA and append each input line to the population.
Reconcile the control count to the four quarterly certification campaigns; investigate any control certified but absent from the matrix export.
testing.done: a reconciled population of controls and CISSA inputs is documented with counts agreed to the certification campaigns.

testing.step: Reconcile the population to the statutory forms
actions: Map every line of the filed statutory financial statements and CISSA schedules to at least one population control.
List any form line or CISSA input with no covering control as a design-gap exception.
Confirm controls added mid-year trace to a change-impact assessment approved by the Controller.
testing.done: every form line maps to a control or is listed as a design-gap exception.

testing.step: Draw a documented control sample
actions: Select 100% of key controls and a random, seeded 25% of non-key controls, minimum 25 controls.
For each sampled control pick occurrences per frequency: 1 annual, 2 quarterly, 2 monthly, 5 daily.
Record seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper so the sample can be re-drawn.
testing.done: a reproducible sample covering all key controls is documented in the workpaper.

testing.step: Re-perform sampled close controls in BlackLine
actions: For each sampled reconciliation occurrence, open the BlackLine certification and re-tie the certified balance to the SAP trial balance and sub-ledger extract.
Re-age unreconciled items and check none over the USD 25k threshold was certified.
Verify the certifier and approver are different users and match the matrix owner.
Screenshot each re-performed certification into the workpaper.
testing.done: each sampled occurrence re-performs cleanly or is logged as an exception with the evidence captured.

testing.step: Re-perform the CISSA input reconciliation
actions: Independently re-tie 10 CISSA input lines, including all capital-resources lines, to the SAP statutory trial balance or signed valuation workpapers.
Recompute the year-on-year movement on each line and check every >10% movement carries a written explanation.
Compare the filed CISSA figures to the board-approved version hash; any difference is an automatic exception.
testing.done: re-tied inputs match the filed CISSA and the board-approved version, with movements explained.

testing.step: Trace the CISSA to board approval and timely filing
actions: Open the board portal minute and confirm the approval resolution pre-dates the BMA submission date.
Compare the submission confirmation date to the 30 April (four months after year-end) deadline and note any extension granted in writing by the BMA.
Recompute the FCR publication day-count: website publication date minus BMA filing date must be 14 days or fewer.
testing.done: the filed CISSA was board-approved first, filed by the deadline, and the FCR published within 14 days.

testing.step: Test the deficiency log end to end
actions: Select every key-control deficiency logged in the year plus 5 random non-key deficiencies.
Verify each has root cause, owner, remediation date, and a re-tested closure instance or an Audit Committee disclosure.
Check no deficiency discovered in testing was absent from the log — an unlogged failure is a separate exception.
testing.done: all sampled deficiencies are complete in the log and no unlogged failure was found.

testing.step: Verify s.18 record retention and retrievability
actions: Request retrieval of 5 record classes from the s.18 inventory via the Bermuda principal office and time the responses.
Confirm retention labels of at least 5 years on each sampled evidence folder.
Check the year's retrieval drill was performed and passed.
testing.done: sampled records were produced from the principal office with compliant retention labels.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one tracker issue per exception with control id or CISSA line, period, and financial-statement or filing impact.
Assign root cause and a named owner with a remediation date; flag any exception affecting a filed figure to the Regulatory Reporting Manager for BMA-notification assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's test as mandatory retest rows.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and a filed-figure impact call.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the key-control failure rate against the zero-unremediated-failure threshold and state the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Have the Chief Audit Executive — who operated and certified none of the tested controls — sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion and open breaches to the Audit Committee and file the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository under Bermuda/REG-057/ICFR-test/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and committee reporting date is filed in the repository.

checklist.step: Confirm the approved auditor of record before planning
actions: Obtain from the Corporate Secretary the current s.16 auditor appointment letter and the BMA approval of that auditor.
Check the engagement letter year matches the financial year under audit.
If the auditor changed in-year, confirm the BMA was notified of the cessation in writing within 14 days and the successor holds BMA approval before fieldwork.
File the appointment and approval evidence in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: a BMA-approved auditor of record with a current engagement letter is evidenced before the test plan is issued.

checklist.step: Agree the reliance scope with the approved auditor
actions: Meet the approved auditor's engagement lead and obtain their list of controls they intend to rely on for the statutory and GAAP audits.
Reconcile that list to the Bermuda ICFR matrix; controls relied on but not on the matrix go back to the Controller as design gaps.
Minute the agreed reliance scope, timing and evidence-sharing protocol.
Load the agreed scope into AuditBoard as the annual test plan.
checklist.done: a minuted reliance scope exists and is loaded as the AuditBoard test plan.

checklist.step: Set sample sizes and test procedures per control
actions: In AuditBoard, attach to each planned control a test procedure naming the evidence to inspect, the attribute tested and the sample size (1 annual, 2 quarterly, 2 monthly, 25 daily/automated).
Mark automated controls for a test-of-one plus an IT general-controls dependency check.
Route the procedures to the Audit Analyst for QA before fieldwork opens.
Freeze the plan version and record the freeze date.
checklist.done: every planned control has a QA-reviewed procedure, sample size and frozen plan version.

checklist.step: Pull system-generated populations for testing
actions: Extract from SAP the journal, reconciliation and access populations for each sampled control period, using saved extract definitions with row counts logged.
Validate completeness by agreeing extract totals to the trial balance or the BlackLine task count for the period.
Store the raw extracts read-only in the AuditBoard project workspace.
Document the extract source, date and parameters on each workpaper.
checklist.done: populations are extracted, completeness-agreed and stored read-only with parameters documented.

checklist.step: Execute interim testing at Q3
actions: Work each planned test in AuditBoard: inspect the sampled evidence, record the attribute result, and attach the evidence instance to the test step.
For reconciliations, re-tie one sampled certification to the SAP balance rather than accepting the sign-off on its face.
Mark each test Pass or Fail — no 'pass with comment' results.
Complete interim testing by the T-60 milestone.
checklist.done: all interim tests are executed with evidence attached and a Pass/Fail result by T-60.

checklist.step: Raise a deficiency for every failed attribute
actions: Open an AuditBoard issue per failure with control id, period, attribute failed and the misstatement or solvency-figure exposure.
Grade severity (deficiency / significant deficiency / material weakness) using the documented scale and the exposure amount.
Notify the control owner and the Controller the same week.
Share significant deficiencies with the approved auditor's engagement lead per the agreed protocol.
checklist.done: every failure is an issue with severity, exposure and owner, and significant items are with the auditor.

checklist.step: Drive remediation with the control owners
actions: Agree a remediation action and date with each failed control's owner, targeting closure before the T-21 milestone.
For design gaps, have the Controller redesign the control and update the ICFR matrix version.
Collect the first post-fix evidence instance from the owner as proof the fix operates.
Update the AuditBoard issue with the fix, date and evidence link.
checklist.done: each deficiency has an implemented fix with post-fix evidence attached before T-21.

checklist.step: Re-test remediated controls
actions: Re-test at least one post-remediation occurrence of every failed key control, two for daily controls.
Record the re-test as a new test step linked to the original issue — never overwrite the failed result.
Close the issue only on a passing re-test signed by the CAE.
Route re-test failures back to remediation and escalate to the CFO.
checklist.done: every remediated key control has a passing, CAE-signed re-test linked to the original issue.

checklist.step: Run year-end update testing
actions: Test the roll-forward period (interim date to year-end) for each key control with at least one occurrence.
Confirm no control changed design since interim without a change-impact assessment.
Refresh the deficiency log so it states the year-end position of every issue.
Deliver the update-testing results to the approved auditor before their year-end fieldwork closes.
checklist.done: roll-forward testing is complete and the year-end deficiency position is with the auditor.

checklist.step: Support the approved auditor's fieldwork requests
actions: Operate the audit request list on the shared SharePoint site: log each auditor request, owner and due date.
Deliver workpapers and evidence within 5 business days of request; track aging and chase owners at day 3.
Record every item the auditor rejects or re-requests, and the reason.
Ensure the auditor receives s.16A access — no request is refused without General Counsel's written direction.
checklist.done: all auditor requests are logged, delivered inside 5 business days or escalated, with none refused unilaterally.

checklist.step: Disposition deficiencies that cannot be remediated in time
actions: For each key deficiency still open at T-21, document the compensating control or quantify the untreated exposure.
Present the open list to the CFO and the approved auditor before the opinion date.
Record the auditor's conclusion on audit impact in the issue.
Never close an issue by waiver — only remediation, compensating control, or reported acceptance.
checklist.done: every open key deficiency at opinion date carries a documented disposition known to the auditor.

checklist.step: Report results to the Audit Committee
actions: Prepare the annual control-testing report: scope, pass rates, deficiency list by severity, remediation status and audit impact.
Load the report to the board portal for the Audit Committee meeting preceding statutory-filing approval.
Present the report and record directed actions in the minutes.
File the minuted report in the compliance evidence repository.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee has minuted the testing report before the statutory filings were approved.

checklist.step: Confirm the audit opinion supports the statutory filing
actions: Obtain the signed audit opinion on the statutory and GAAP financial statements from the approved auditor.
Check the opinion names the BMA-approved audit firm, the correct entity and financial year, and is dated before submission.
Attach the opinion to the statutory financial return package for the 30 April filing.
Log the opinion date and any modification or emphasis of matter in the filing tracker.
checklist.done: a signed, dated opinion from the approved auditor is attached to the filing package with modifications logged.

checklist.step: Capture auditor communications and management letter points
actions: Log every management letter point and s.16A auditor communication in AuditBoard with an owner and due date.
Cross-reference each point to an existing deficiency or open a new issue.
Draft management responses and obtain CFO approval before returning them to the auditor.
Track each point to closure in the following year's plan.
checklist.done: all auditor points are logged with owners, approved responses and closure tracking.

checklist.step: Archive the testing cycle evidence
actions: Mirror the AuditBoard project (plan, workpapers, issues, re-tests, committee report) to the compliance evidence repository under Bermuda/REG-057/control-testing/<year>.
Apply the 5-year retention label and lock the folder read-only.
Verify retrieval by control id and by deficiency id.
Record the archive date in the compliance calendar.
checklist.done: the full cycle is archived read-only with retention labels and verified retrieval.

testing.step: Build the population of planned tests and raised deficiencies
actions: Export the frozen annual test plan and every executed test step with result and evidence link.
Export the full deficiency log for the year including closed and dispositioned issues.
Reconcile executed tests to the frozen plan; any planned test never executed is an automatic exception.
testing.done: plan, executions and deficiencies are extracted and reconciled with unexecuted tests flagged.

testing.step: Reconcile the plan to the auditor reliance scope
actions: Compare the frozen plan to the minuted reliance scope agreed with the approved auditor.
List any reliance control missing from the plan as a scope exception.
Confirm scope changes in-year carry a minuted agreement with the auditor.
testing.done: the plan covers the full reliance scope or exceptions are listed with the minute trail.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of executed tests
actions: Select all failed tests, all key-control tests, and a seeded random 20% of passing non-key tests, minimum 20 tests.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
Pull the attached evidence for every sampled test.
testing.done: a reproducible sample including 100% of failures and key controls is documented.

testing.step: Re-perform sampled tests against the underlying evidence
actions: For each sampled test, open the attached evidence and independently re-reach the Pass/Fail call without reading the tester's conclusion first.
Re-tie one sampled reconciliation test to the SAP trial balance figure it certified.
Treat 'pass' results with missing or period-mismatched evidence as fails.
Record each re-performance note in the workpaper.
testing.done: every sampled test has an independent re-performance note and evidence-supported result.

testing.step: Verify population completeness behind the tests
actions: For 5 sampled tests, re-run the documented SAP extract parameters and compare row counts to the stored population.
Check the completeness tie-out (trial balance or BlackLine task count) was documented at extraction time.
Flag any test worked on an unvalidated population.
testing.done: sampled populations reproduce with documented completeness tie-outs.

testing.step: Test the deficiency lifecycle on every failure
actions: For each failed test, verify an issue exists with severity, exposure, root cause, owner and date, raised within a week of the failure.
Verify closed issues carry a passing re-test signed by the CAE, on a new test step — an overwritten result is an exception.
Verify issues open at opinion date carry a documented disposition and evidence the auditor was told.
testing.done: every failure traces through issue, remediation, signed re-test or disposition, with auditor notification evidenced.

testing.step: Recompute the milestone and deadline maths
actions: Recompute interim completion vs T-60, remediation closure vs T-21, and both vs the audit opinion date.
Confirm the opinion date precedes the statutory filing submission date, itself within four months of year-end (30 April for a 31 December year-end) absent a written BMA extension.
For any in-year auditor change, recompute the cessation-notification day-count against the 14-day requirement.
testing.done: all milestone, opinion and 14-day notification day-counts recompute inside their limits or are logged as exceptions.

testing.step: Trace committee and auditor reporting
actions: Open the Audit Committee minute and confirm the testing report was tabled before filing approval.
Trace two significant deficiencies to the evidence they were shared with the auditor's engagement lead.
Confirm management letter points are logged with approved responses.
testing.done: committee tabling and auditor sharing are evidenced for the sampled items.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception naming the control or test, the period and the audit-reliance impact.
Assign root cause (plan gap, evidence gap, late remediation, unreported deficiency) and an owner with a date.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification as mandatory retest rows.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and file the verification
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-open-key-deficiency threshold and write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Have the Head of Compliance — who executed none of the sampled tests — sign the workpaper.
File the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository under Bermuda/REG-057/control-testing-verification/<year> and report the conclusion to the Audit Committee.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to the committee.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Board Governance Lead runs the Audit Committee's s.16 auditor approval, independence and rotation checks; escalation to the Audit Committee chair and General Counsel

checklist.step: Verify the audit firm holds current BMA approved-auditor status
actions: Before each engagement renewal, obtain from the audit firm its evidence of BMA approved-auditor status for Bermuda insurance audits.
Cross-check the firm and signing office against the BMA's published approved-auditor expectations; where doubt exists, email the BMA supervision contact and file the reply.
Record the approval evidence, date checked and checker on the engagement file.
Block engagement signature until the approval evidence is on file.
checklist.done: documented BMA approval evidence for the firm is on the engagement file before signature.

checklist.step: Collect the annual audit independence letter
actions: Request the firm's written independence confirmation covering the firm, network firms and the engagement team, addressed to the Audit Committee.
Check the letter covers financial interests, business relationships, employment relationships and non-audit services, and is dated before fieldwork begins.
Chase at fieldwork minus 30 days if not received; escalate to the Audit Committee chair at minus 14 days.
File the letter in the compliance evidence repository under the engagement year.
checklist.done: a dated, fieldwork-preceding independence letter covering firm and network is on file.

checklist.step: Maintain the lead-partner rotation tracker
actions: Maintain a tracker row per engagement: lead audit partner, engagement quality reviewer, first year on the engagement and computed years of tenure.
Compute tenure each renewal; flag any partner at year 6 so a successor is named a year ahead of the 7-year rotation limit.
Obtain the firm's written confirmation of partner start years and file it behind the tracker.
Present the tracker at the annual engagement-approval committee meeting.
checklist.done: the tracker shows current tenure for both partners with successor planning flagged from year 6.

checklist.step: Run non-audit-services pre-approval
actions: Route every proposed non-audit engagement with the audit firm or its network through the board portal pre-approval workflow before work starts.
Record service description, fee, prohibited-services screen result and the approver on the register.
Apply the fee-cap policy: cumulative non-audit fees above the committee's threshold require full-committee approval, not chair-only.
Reject and log any engagement discovered post-hoc as an exception.
checklist.done: every non-audit engagement carries a pre-dated approval entry with fee and screen result on the register.

checklist.step: Screen for prohibited relationships each year
actions: Circulate the annual conflicts questionnaire to directors and executive officers asking for financial or family relationships with the audit firm.
Check recent hires in Finance against the audit firm's engagement-team roster for cooling-off issues before they supervise the audit relationship.
Log any relationship found and refer it to General Counsel for an independence assessment.
File the completed questionnaires and assessment outcomes.
checklist.done: questionnaires are returned, hires screened, and any relationship carries a counsel assessment.

checklist.step: Approve the engagement at the Audit Committee
actions: Table the engagement letter, fee proposal, independence letter, rotation tracker and non-audit-services register at the committee meeting.
Record the committee's approval resolution, including reappointment of the approved auditor for the financial year, in the minutes.
Have the engagement letter countersigned only after the resolution passes.
File the minute with the engagement pack.
checklist.done: a committee resolution approving the engagement pre-dates the countersigned engagement letter.

checklist.step: Confirm shareholder appointment formalities
actions: Include the auditor appointment and remuneration authority in the AGM resolutions where the bye-laws require it.
Record the passed resolution in the AGM minutes and update the statutory registers.
Cross-file the resolution reference on the engagement file.
Diarise the next appointment resolution in the governance calendar.
checklist.done: the appointment resolution is passed, minuted and referenced on the engagement file.

checklist.step: Monitor fees by service type through the year
actions: Code every audit-firm invoice in SAP to audit, audit-related, tax or other non-audit service using the dedicated vendor cost elements.
Match each non-audit invoice to its pre-approval register entry before posting; park unmatched invoices and alert the Board Governance Lead.
Produce the quarterly fee-by-type report and send it to the Corporate Secretary.
Reconcile year-end totals to the figures disclosed to the committee.
checklist.done: all invoices are coded, matched to pre-approvals, and quarterly fee reports reconcile to disclosures.

checklist.step: Handle auditor resignation or removal events
actions: On any resignation, removal or non-reappointment, open the cessation checklist the same day.
Draft the written notice to the BMA and send it within 14 days of the cessation, stating the reasons.
Obtain the outgoing auditor's statement of circumstances and table it at the committee.
Start the replacement approval process so a BMA-approved successor is appointed without a coverage gap.
checklist.done: the BMA notice is sent within 14 days and the successor process is opened with the statement of circumstances tabled.

checklist.step: Verify the engagement quality reviewer is independent
actions: Obtain the firm's confirmation of the engagement quality reviewer's identity and independence from the engagement team.
Check the reviewer appears on the rotation tracker with tenure computed.
Confirm the reviewer took no other role on the engagement during the year.
File the confirmation with the independence letter.
checklist.done: the quality reviewer is named, tracked and confirmed independent in writing.

checklist.step: Brief the committee on auditor performance and independence mid-cycle
actions: Prepare a mid-cycle paper: fees to date by type, new non-audit approvals, any independence events and audit progress.
Table it at the committee and minute questions to the audit firm.
Route committee-directed questions to the engagement lead in writing and log the answers.
File the paper and responses.
checklist.done: a minuted mid-cycle independence and performance review exists with firm responses logged.

checklist.step: Assess independence before accepting the audit opinion
actions: Before the opinion is accepted, review the year's exception log, fee ledger and independence letter for any event compromising independence.
Where an event occurred, obtain the firm's safeguards memo and conclude in writing whether independence held.
Report the conclusion to the Audit Committee ahead of statutory-filing approval.
File the written conclusion on the engagement file.
checklist.done: a written pre-opinion independence conclusion by counsel is on file and reported to the committee.

checklist.step: Log and remediate independence exceptions
actions: Raise a tracker issue for each exception: unapproved non-audit service, lapsed letter, rotation breach or relationship finding.
Assign root cause and owner; terminate or restructure any prohibited service found running.
Obtain General Counsel sign-off on each closure.
Report open exceptions in every committee pack until closed.
checklist.done: every exception is tracked, remediated with counsel sign-off, and reported until closed.

checklist.step: Confirm the successor-firm transition preserves audit coverage
actions: On any firm change, agree the handover protocol: predecessor workpaper access, opening-balance procedures and timing against the 30 April filing.
Confirm the successor's BMA approval evidence is on file before any fieldwork.
Track transition milestones weekly until the first opinion is delivered.
Escalate to the CFO if the transition threatens the statutory filing date.
checklist.done: a firm transition, if any, is evidenced, BMA-approved and tracked without threatening the filing date.

checklist.step: Archive the engagement governance file
actions: Assemble the year file: approval evidence, engagement letter, independence letters, rotation tracker, pre-approval register, fee reports, minutes and counsel conclusions.
Apply the 7-year retention label and index by engagement year.
Verify retrieval by firm name and year.
Record completion in the governance calendar.
checklist.done: the complete engagement governance file is archived with 7-year retention and verified retrieval.

testing.step: Build the population of audit-firm engagements and fees
actions: Extract from SAP every posting to the audit firm's vendor accounts (and known network-firm vendors) for the year, by cost element and amount.
Pull the non-audit-services pre-approval register and the engagement list from the Corporate Secretary.
Reconcile total fees per SAP to the fee report presented to the committee; investigate differences over 5%.
testing.done: a reconciled population of engagements and fees exists with SAP-to-committee differences resolved.

testing.step: Reconcile every invoice to a pre-approved engagement
actions: Match each non-audit invoice line to a register entry on service description and fee.
Check the register approval date pre-dates the earliest work evidenced on the invoice.
List unmatched or post-dated approvals as automatic exceptions.
testing.done: every non-audit invoice matches a pre-dated approval or is listed as an exception.

testing.step: Verify BMA approved-auditor evidence for the engagement year
actions: Inspect the engagement file for the firm's BMA approval evidence and the date it was checked.
Confirm the audit opinion signing office matches the approved firm entity.
For any in-year firm or partner change, inspect the successor's approval evidence dated before fieldwork.
testing.done: approval evidence pre-dating signature exists for every firm entity that signed in the year.

testing.step: Re-perform the rotation tenure computation
actions: Recompute lead partner and quality reviewer tenure from the firm's confirmed start years, independently of the tracker.
Compare to the tracker and to the 7-year limit; a partner at year 8 is a reportable breach, not an exception.
Check a successor was named by year 6 where flagged.
testing.done: recomputed tenure matches the tracker and no partner exceeds the rotation limit.

testing.step: Inspect the independence letter and its timing
actions: Read the year's independence letter and confirm it covers firm, network and engagement team, addressed to the Audit Committee.
Compare the letter date to the fieldwork start date in the audit plan — the letter must come first.
Trace counsel's pre-opinion independence conclusion and confirm it pre-dates opinion acceptance.
testing.done: letter coverage, letter-before-fieldwork and conclusion-before-opinion are all evidenced.

testing.step: Test committee approval sequencing
actions: Open the committee minutes and confirm the engagement approval resolution pre-dates the countersigned engagement letter.
Confirm the AGM appointment resolution exists where the bye-laws require it.
Check the mid-cycle independence paper was tabled and minuted.
testing.done: approval, appointment and mid-cycle review are minuted in the correct sequence.

testing.step: Recompute cessation notification day-counts
actions: For any auditor cessation in the year, compute BMA notice date minus cessation date and compare to the 14-day limit.
Inspect the notice content for the stated reasons and the outgoing auditor's statement of circumstances.
Where no cessation occurred, document that the check was performed with a nil result.
testing.done: any cessation notice recomputes within 14 days, or a nil result is documented.

testing.step: Sample-test the prohibited-services screen
actions: Select 5 approved non-audit engagements and re-perform the prohibited-services screen against the procedure's prohibited list.
Check cumulative non-audit fees against the committee threshold and confirm full-committee approval where the cap was crossed.
Flag any service that should have been screened out.
testing.done: sampled services re-screen clean and fee-cap approvals are at the right authority level.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the engagement, amount and independence impact.
Assign root cause (register bypass, tracker error, late letter, notice delay) and an owner with a date.
Refer any exception implying an independence breach to General Counsel for a reporting assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and a counsel referral where warranted.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the verification
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-unapproved-service and rotation thresholds and state the conclusion.
Have the Chief Audit Executive — who maintains none of the governance records tested — sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper under Bermuda/REG-057/auditor-independence/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to the committee.

checklist.step: Publish the year-end close and filing timetable
actions: Back-compute the timetable from the 30 April BMA deadline: audit opinion target, committee approval date, consolidation lock, sub-ledger closes and actuarial deliverable dates.
Circulate the timetable to the Appointed Actuary, Statutory Reporting Manager, Tax Manager and the approved auditor's engagement lead, and collect written acceptance of their dates.
Load every milestone into the filing calendar with the T-90 to T-7 alert ladder.
File the accepted timetable in the financial reporting repository.
checklist.done: an accepted timetable back-computed from 30 April is published with alerts armed.

checklist.step: Confirm the acceptable-GAAP basis for the statements
actions: Confirm the elected reporting basis (US GAAP) remains one of the s.17A acceptable GAAPs (Bermuda, Canada, UK or US GAAP, or IFRS where permitted) and matches the prior-year election.
If a basis change is proposed, obtain the approved auditor's concurrence and notify the BMA before adoption.
Record the basis and the check date on the filing file.
Brief the close team on any new standards effective this year-end.
checklist.done: the GAAP basis is confirmed acceptable and consistent, with any change agreed and notified.

checklist.step: Execute the year-end close in the source ledger
actions: Run the year-end close cockpit tasks in SAP for the Bermuda entity: sub-ledger closes, FX revaluation, accrual and reserve top-side entries with approvals attached.
Certify all year-end balance-sheet reconciliations in BlackLine with items over the USD 25k threshold cleared or explained.
Lock the period in SAP once the Controller approves the trial balance.
Export the final trial balance and file it with a row-count and hash.
checklist.done: the period is locked with certified reconciliations and a filed final trial balance.

checklist.step: Load and consolidate into the GAAP statements
actions: Load the locked trial balance into the consolidation tool and run the mapping to GAAP statement lines.
Clear every unmapped account before proceeding — no plug lines.
Post consolidation and elimination entries with support attached.
Tie the draft statements' totals back to the SAP trial balance and record the tie-out.
checklist.done: draft GAAP statements exist with zero unmapped accounts and a documented trial-balance tie-out.

checklist.step: Obtain the actuarial balances and opinion linkage
actions: Obtain from the Appointed Actuary the signed year-end reserve figures and confirm they equal the statement technical-provision lines to the dollar.
Obtain the loss reserve specialist's opinion timeline so it lands before the audit opinion date.
Document any difference between actuarial and booked figures and clear it with both signatories.
File the signed actuarial deliverables with the statement support.
checklist.done: booked reserves equal the signed actuarial figures and the opinion timeline supports the audit date.

checklist.step: Draft the notes and disclosures
actions: Draft the full note set from the prior-year shell: basis of preparation, reserves, reinsurance, capital and solvency, related parties and subsequent events.
Update the capital note to the current BSCR and minimum-margin figures from the Capital Management Manager, in writing.
Run the disclosure checklist for the GAAP basis and tick every line with a preparer and reviewer initial.
Store the drafts with tracked versions in the repository.
checklist.done: a complete note set passes the disclosure checklist with dual initials and current capital figures.

checklist.step: Manage the audit to the opinion date
actions: Deliver the auditor's request list items within 5 business days each, tracked on the shared request log.
Hold weekly status calls with the engagement lead; log open items, adjustments proposed and their statement impact.
Post agreed audit adjustments in the consolidation tool and refresh the tie-outs.
Obtain the summary of unadjusted differences and the CFO's decision on each.
checklist.done: audit fieldwork is complete with adjustments posted and unadjusted differences dispositioned by the CFO.

checklist.step: Obtain the signed management representation letter
actions: Review the auditor's draft representation letter against the year's known issues with General Counsel.
Have the CFO and Controller sign, dated the same date as the audit opinion.
Return the signed letter to the auditor and keep a copy in the filing file.
Log any negotiated changes to the standard wording.
checklist.done: a signed representation letter dated with the opinion is delivered and filed.

checklist.step: Secure board approval of the audited statements
actions: Load the audited statements, the draft opinion and the audit-results memo to the board portal ahead of the approval meeting scheduled before the filing date.
Record the board resolution approving the statements and authorising signature by two directors.
Collect the wet or platform signatures on the balance sheet page.
File the minute and signed set in the financial reporting repository.
checklist.done: board-approved, director-signed statements exist with the minute filed before submission.

checklist.step: Receive and check the signed audit opinion
actions: Obtain the signed opinion from the BMA-approved auditor and check entity name, year, GAAP basis and opinion date.
Confirm the opinion is unmodified, or route any modification to the CFO and Regulatory Counsel for a pre-filing BMA communication decision.
Assemble the final filing set: signed statements, opinion, and required auditor communications.
Page-check the assembled PDF against the approved version.
checklist.done: a checked, signed opinion is assembled into the final filing set matching the approved version.

checklist.step: Decide the extension question at the T-45 gate
actions: At T-45 days, assess whether the opinion date will hold; if not, draft the s.17A extension application stating reasons and the requested date (up to 31 July).
Submit the application to the BMA before 30 April and obtain the written grant.
Re-set the filing calendar to the granted date and notify the close team.
File the application and grant in the filing file.
checklist.done: either the timetable holds at T-45, or a granted extension letter re-sets the deadline before it passes.

checklist.step: Submit the filing to the BMA and capture confirmation
actions: Log in to the BMA electronic filing portal with the entity's credentials and open the annual filings section for the reporting year.
Upload the audited GAAP statements and auditor communications to the correct submission slots and complete the declaration fields.
Submit on or before 30 April (or the granted extension date) and save the portal confirmation receipt with its timestamp.
Record the submission date, submitter and receipt reference in the filing tracker.
checklist.done: the portal receipt shows a complete submission on or before the applicable deadline, logged in the tracker.

checklist.step: Certify the filing internally
actions: Complete the filing-approval certificate: package contents, deadline computation, submission evidence and sign-offs obtained.
Obtain the CFO's signature on the certificate within 5 business days of submission.
Attach the certificate to the filing file.
Report completion at the next finance leadership meeting.
checklist.done: a CFO-signed certificate confirming a complete, timely filing is on the filing file.

checklist.step: Answer BMA follow-up queries
actions: Log every BMA query on the filing in the tracker with its response due date.
Draft responses with the Controller; route any response touching lateness, restatement or a modified opinion through Regulatory Counsel.
Send responses by the BMA's stated date and file the correspondence.
Track queries to written closure.
checklist.done: all BMA queries are logged, counsel-cleared where needed, answered on time and closed in writing.

checklist.step: Archive the filing evidence set
actions: Assemble the year folder: timetable, trial balance, tie-outs, signed statements, opinion, representation letter, board minute, extension grant if any, portal receipt and certificate.
Apply the 7-year retention label and index by entity and year.
Verify retrieval by year and document type.
Record completion in the compliance calendar.
checklist.done: the complete filing evidence set is archived with retention labels and verified retrieval.

testing.step: Build the population of BMA filings due in the year
actions: List every BMA financial filing due for the entity in the year from the filing calendar: audited statements, auditor communications and extension applications.
Reconcile the list to the BMA correspondence file and the filing tracker so no due filing is missing from the population.
Record the population and its sources in the workpaper.
testing.done: a reconciled population of due filings is documented against calendar, tracker and correspondence.

testing.step: Reconcile the filed set to the board-approved statements
actions: Retrieve the submitted package from the repository and the portal receipt.
Page-compare the filed statements to the board-approved, director-signed version — totals, note numbering and the signed balance sheet page.
Any difference between filed and approved versions is an automatic exception.
testing.done: the filed package is page-identical to the approved signed version.

testing.step: Recompute the filing deadline and timeliness
actions: Compute year-end plus four months and compare to the portal receipt timestamp.
Where an extension was used, inspect the application and the BMA grant, confirm the application pre-dates 30 April, and re-run the day-count to the granted date.
Classify the filing on-time or late with the arithmetic shown.
testing.done: the timeliness call is recomputed from source dates with extension evidence inspected.

testing.step: Verify the audit opinion in the filed set
actions: Inspect the filed opinion for the BMA-approved firm's signature, entity, year, GAAP basis and a date on or before submission.
Cross-check the firm against the s.16 approval evidence on the engagement file.
For any modified opinion, trace the pre-filing communication decision to Regulatory Counsel's record.
testing.done: the filed opinion is signed by the approved auditor, correctly dated, with modifications dispositioned.

testing.step: Re-perform the statement tie-out to the ledger
actions: Independently re-tie total assets, total liabilities, equity and net income in the filed statements to the locked SAP trial balance through the consolidation mapping.
Re-tie the technical-provision lines to the Appointed Actuary's signed figures.
Verify audit adjustments posted in the tool match the auditor's adjustment schedule.
testing.done: filed headline figures re-tie to the locked ledger and signed actuarial figures.

testing.step: Draw a sample of supporting reconciliations
actions: Select a seeded random 10 year-end balance-sheet reconciliations weighted to the largest balances.
Record seed, population and selection date so the sample can be re-drawn.
Pull the BlackLine certifications for each.
testing.done: a reproducible sample of year-end reconciliations is documented.

testing.step: Re-perform the sampled reconciliations
actions: Re-tie each sampled certification to the SAP balance and sub-ledger extract.
Check items over the USD 25k threshold were cleared or explained before certification.
Verify certifier/approver segregation on each.
testing.done: sampled reconciliations re-perform cleanly with threshold and segregation rules held.

testing.step: Verify approval and sign-off sequencing
actions: Confirm the board approval minute pre-dates submission and the director signatures match the resolution's authorised signatories.
Confirm the representation letter date equals the opinion date.
Confirm the CFO filing certificate was signed within 5 business days of submission.
testing.done: approval, representation and certification dates sequence correctly against submission.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the filing, the defect and the regulatory exposure.
Assign root cause (timetable slip, version control, portal error, opinion delay) and an owner with a date.
Refer any late or incomplete filing to Regulatory Counsel for a proactive-notification assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and a counsel referral where warranted.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the verification
actions: State the conclusion against the on-time, complete-package thresholds (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Have the Chief Audit Executive — who prepared and submitted nothing in the package — sign the workpaper.
Report to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper under Bermuda/REG-057/annual-filing/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to the committee.

checklist.step: Cut and validate the valuation data
actions: Extract paid, case and premium triangles by segment from the warehouse claims and policy marts as at the quarter-end data-cut date.
Reconcile extract totals to the SAP ledger paid-loss and case-reserve balances within the 0.5% tolerance and to the claims platform open-count report.
Run the validation suite: negative increments, missing accident periods, large-movement outliers; log every flag.
Obtain the Claims Director / Manager's written confirmation of large-loss case reserves over the USD 1m threshold.
Freeze the validated extract and record its hash and row counts in the data log.
checklist.done: a frozen, hash-logged extract reconciles to ledger and claims counts within tolerance with all flags dispositioned.

checklist.step: Roll forward the reserving segments and exposure data
actions: In Arius open the prior-quarter project, roll the evaluation date forward and import the frozen extract.
Confirm segment definitions match the statutory statement line mapping; log any book-of-business change from Underwriting.
Load earned premium and rate-change data from the Pricing Actuary as exposure bases.
Verify the imported triangles foot to the extract totals.
checklist.done: the Arius project is rolled forward with triangles footing to the frozen extract and segment mapping confirmed.

checklist.step: Run the projection methods per segment
actions: Run the procedure's method set per segment in Arius: paid and incurred chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and expected loss ratio.
Update development factor selections only with a documented reason on each changed factor.
Produce the actual-versus-expected diagnostic against the prior quarter's selections and flag segments breaching the tolerance bands.
Export the method results pack for the selection meeting.
checklist.done: all methods are run with documented factor changes and an A-vs-E pack flagging out-of-tolerance segments.

checklist.step: Select central estimates at the reserve committee
actions: Chair the quarterly reserve selection meeting with the Reserving Actuary, Chief Actuary and Controller.
Select the central estimate per segment, recording the method weighting and rationale in the selection memo.
Document every override of an indicated result with its quantified impact and reason.
Circulate the signed selection memo within 3 business days of the meeting.
checklist.done: a signed selection memo records estimates, weightings and overrides for every segment.

checklist.step: Build the EBS technical provisions
actions: Convert selected undiscounted reserves to the EBS best estimate: derive payout patterns per segment and discount on the BMA-published risk-free curves for the quarter.
Compute the risk margin per the BMA's prescribed cost-of-capital approach and document the projection of capital.
Add premium provisions for unincepted and unexpired exposure from the in-force extract.
Reconcile statutory-to-EBS reserve movements in the bridge schedule and file it.
checklist.done: EBS best estimate, risk margin and premium provisions are computed on current BMA curves with a filed bridge schedule.

checklist.step: Peer-review the valuation
actions: Assign each segment a peer reviewer who performed no projection on it.
Re-run diagnostics, challenge factor selections and overrides, and record findings on the peer-review checklist.
Return material findings to the Reserving Analyst for rework before sign-off.
Sign the completed checklist and file it with the quarter's workpapers.
checklist.done: every segment carries a signed peer-review checklist with material findings reworked.

checklist.step: Tie the selected reserves into the ledger
actions: Compute the booking entries from the signed selection memo: IBNR by segment and line of business.
Post the entries in SAP with the memo attached as support and route for Controller approval.
Re-run the reserve tie-out: booked reserves versus signed selections, difference must be zero.
File the tie-out with both signatures.
checklist.done: booked reserves equal the signed selections to the dollar with an approved, filed tie-out.

checklist.step: Prepare the statutory statement reserve schedules
actions: Populate the Insurance Accounts Regulations 1980 prescribed reserve lines and movement schedules from the booked figures.
Tie each schedule line to the SAP balances and the selection memo.
Cross-check the EBS technical-provision figures destined for the Capital and Solvency Return against the bridge schedule.
Route the schedules to the Appointed Actuary for confirmation.
checklist.done: prescribed reserve schedules tie to ledger and memo, confirmed by the Appointed Actuary.

checklist.step: Write the annual valuation report
actions: Write the annual report: data, methods, assumptions, selections, A-vs-E for the year, EBS build, sensitivities and uncertainty commentary.
Include the reconciliation from prior-year selections to current, explaining releases and strengthenings by segment.
Address every open valuation-issues-log item with its disposition.
Deliver the report to the Chief Actuary, CFO and the approved auditor by the audit-deliverable date.
checklist.done: the annual valuation report is delivered on time covering methods, movements, EBS and open issues.

checklist.step: Support the loss reserve specialist and auditor review
actions: Provide the loss reserve specialist and the auditor's actuaries the frozen extracts, Arius project files and selection memos on request, logged on the request list.
Reproduce any requested projection live in Arius during their walkthroughs.
Log every challenge raised and the Appointed Actuary's written resolution.
Track the specialist's opinion timeline against the filing calendar.
checklist.done: reviewer requests are fulfilled from logged evidence and challenges carry written resolutions.

checklist.step: Run the year-end assumption review
actions: Review tail factors, trend and ELR assumptions annually against the year's emergence and current market data from Pricing.
Approve assumption changes in a dated memo quantifying the reserve impact of each change.
Reject undocumented drift — any assumption differing from last approval without a memo entry is reverted.
File the memo in the model governance repository.
checklist.done: a dated assumption memo approves every change with quantified impact and no undocumented drift.

checklist.step: Log and remediate valuation issues
actions: Log every data failure, tolerance breach and control break in the valuation issues log with segment, quarter and impact.
Assign owner and remediation date; fixes affecting booked figures need the Chief Actuary's signature.
Re-run affected diagnostics after each fix and attach the re-run evidence.
Review the open log at each selection meeting.
checklist.done: the issues log is current with owned, dated items and signed fixes re-verified.

checklist.step: Report reserve movements to governance
actions: Prepare the quarterly reserve report for the Audit Committee: movements by segment, A-vs-E, override summary and uncertainty ranges.
Table the annual report conclusions before the statutory statements are approved.
Minute directed actions and track them in the issues log.
File the tabled packs in the repository.
checklist.done: quarterly and annual reserve reporting is tabled and minuted before statement approval.

checklist.step: Maintain model change control on the reserving platforms
actions: Register Arius and the EBS models in the model inventory with owner, version and last-validation date.
Route every model change through the change-control workflow with testing evidence before production use.
Schedule periodic validation per the model risk policy and track findings to closure.
Block valuation runs on unregistered model versions.
checklist.done: all reserving models are inventoried, change-controlled and within their validation cycle.

checklist.step: Archive the quarter's valuation evidence
actions: File the frozen extract, Arius project, method pack, selection memo, peer-review checklist, tie-out and bridge schedule under <year>/<quarter>.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Verify the set is retrievable by segment and quarter.
Record completion in the valuation calendar.
checklist.done: the complete quarterly evidence set is archived, labelled and retrievable.

testing.step: Build the population of segments, quarters and booked lines
actions: List every reserve segment valued in each of the four quarters from the selection memos.
Extract the booked reserve lines from the statutory statements and EBS schedules.
Reconcile segment coverage: every booked line must map to a valued segment; unmapped lines are exceptions.
testing.done: a complete segment/quarter/booked-line population is documented with unmapped lines flagged.

testing.step: Reconcile booked reserves to signed selections
actions: For all four quarters, re-tie booked IBNR and case reserves in SAP to the signed selection memos to the dollar.
Trace each booking entry's approval to the Controller.
Any difference or unsigned memo is an automatic exception.
testing.done: booked figures re-tie to signed selections for every quarter.

testing.step: Draw a documented segment sample
actions: Select the 3 largest segments by reserve, every segment with an override in the year, and a seeded random 2 others.
Record seed, population and selection date so the sample can be re-drawn.
Pull the full workpaper set for each sampled segment.
testing.done: a reproducible sample covering large and overridden segments is documented.

testing.step: Re-perform the data reconciliation
actions: Re-run the extract for one sampled quarter using the logged parameters and compare hashes and row counts to the frozen extract.
Re-tie extract totals to the SAP paid and case balances and to the claims open-count report within the 0.5% tolerance.
Check the large-loss confirmation from Claims was on file before selection.
testing.done: the extract reproduces and re-ties within tolerance with the claims confirmation evidenced.

testing.step: Re-run projections on a sampled segment
actions: Open the archived Arius project for a sampled segment and re-run the method set; results must match the method pack.
Re-derive two changed development factors and check each carries a documented reason.
Recompute the A-vs-E diagnostic and confirm out-of-tolerance flags were raised where indicated.
testing.done: archived projections reproduce with factor changes documented and diagnostics correctly flagged.

testing.step: Verify overrides and peer review
actions: For every override in the sample, verify the selection memo quantifies impact and states the rationale.
Verify each sampled segment's peer-review checklist is signed by an actuary who ran no projection on it.
Confirm material peer findings were reworked before the memo was signed.
testing.done: all sampled overrides are documented and peer review is genuinely independent and pre-sign-off.

testing.step: Recompute the EBS discounting and risk margin
actions: Recompute the discounted best estimate for one sampled segment using the BMA risk-free curve published for that quarter.
Recompute the risk margin on the prescribed cost-of-capital rate and compare to the filed figure within rounding.
Re-foot the statutory-to-EBS bridge schedule.
testing.done: EBS figures recompute on the correct curves and the bridge re-foots.

testing.step: Verify assumption and model change control
actions: Compare current assumptions to the last approved assumption memo; undocumented differences are exceptions.
Trace two model changes in the year through the change-control workflow with testing evidence.
Check the models' validation dates are within the model risk policy cycle.
testing.done: assumptions match approvals and sampled model changes are controlled and validated.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with segment, quarter and reserve impact.
Assign root cause (data, method, override documentation, tie-out, change control) and an owner with a date.
Refer any exception moving a filed reserve figure to the Appointed Actuary and Regulatory Counsel for a restatement assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and restatement referral where warranted.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the verification
actions: State the conclusion against the booked-equals-signed and tolerance thresholds (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Have the Chief Audit Executive — who performed no valuation work — sign the workpaper.
Report to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper under Bermuda/REG-057/valuation/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to the committee.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Appointed Actuary (the BMA-approved loss reserve specialist / approved actuary) owns preparation and signature of the annual actuarial opinion and supporting memorandum; escalation to the Chief Actuary and CFO

In-scope processes.value: Annual opinion on the adequacy of loss and loss-expense provisions (and long-term liabilities where applicable): scope confirmation, reliance documentation, opinion drafting, memorandum preparation and dual sign-off ahead of the statutory return

In-scope systems.value: Opinion and memorandum drafted and version-controlled in the document repository; valuation support pulled from Arius and the actuarial modeling platform

Compliance procedure documented.value: Actuarial Opinion Procedure — approval status check of the signer, scope and reliance letters, memorandum content standard mirroring the valuation report, wording review against BMA expectations, and signature/dating rules

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Chief Actuary; re-approved when the signer changes, the BMA amends opinion requirements, or business mix adds an opinion segment

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Opinion signed and dated before the statutory financial return filing (30 April for a 31 December year-end); memorandum completed within the same cycle and producible to the BMA on request

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Chief Actuary signs off remediation of every opinion-process exception before the next opinion cycle opens
