checklist.step: Confirm the signer's approved status and appointment
actions: Verify the opinion signer holds current BMA approval as loss reserve specialist (or approved actuary for long-term business) for this insurer, and the approval letter is on file.
Check the signer's professional credential (FCAS/FIA or equivalent) and continuing-education standing with the signer's written confirmation.
If the signer changed, confirm the BMA approved the successor before any opinion work and the change was notified within 14 days.
Record the check date and evidence references on the opinion file.
checklist.done: a currently approved, credentialed signer is evidenced on the opinion file before drafting starts.

checklist.step: Agree the opinion scope at T-60
actions: List every reserve item in scope: gross and net loss and loss-expense provisions, retroactive and assumed reinsurance, and unearned premium where required.
Map each item to the statutory statement line and the valuation segment that produces it.
Confirm with the Statutory Reporting Manager that no statement reserve line falls outside the scope map.
Minute the scope at the opinion-planning meeting.
checklist.done: a minuted scope map covers every statement reserve line with its valuation segment.

checklist.step: Collect data certifications and reliance letters
actions: Obtain the Controller's signed data certification for the ledger balances used in the valuation.
Obtain the Claims Director / Manager's certification of case reserves and the Reinsurance Manager's certification of ceded balances.
Where the signer relies on another actuary's work, obtain a reliance letter naming the work, its date and its scope.
File all certifications in the opinion reliance folder with a completeness checklist.
checklist.done: every reliance in the draft opinion is matched to a signed certification or reliance letter in the folder.

checklist.step: Tie the opinion figures to the signed valuation
actions: Build the opinion exhibit: gross and net reserve amounts by item, tied to the annual selection memo and the SAP booked balances.
Reconcile every figure to the dollar; document and clear any difference before drafting.
Cross-check the EBS technical-provision figures where the opinion references them.
Have the Reserving Actuary initial the completed tie-out.
checklist.done: an initialed exhibit ties every opinion figure to the selection memo and ledger to the dollar.

checklist.step: Draft the opinion wording
actions: Draft the opinion in the repository from the current-year template: identification, scope, reliances, opinion paragraph on reserve adequacy, and any qualification or limitation.
State the review basis (accepted actuarial standards of practice) and the data-reliance boundaries exactly as certified.
Version-control every draft; no offline copies.
Route the draft to the Chief Actuary for challenge at T-30.
checklist.done: a version-controlled draft opinion matching the certified reliances is with the Chief Actuary by T-30.

checklist.step: Prepare the supporting actuarial memorandum
actions: Write the memorandum to the content standard: data, methods, assumptions, segment results, A-vs-E, sensitivities, risk margins and the bridge from indications to opined amounts.
Reference the valuation report rather than duplicating it, but include every exhibit the opinion figures rest on.
Reconcile the memorandum totals to the opinion exhibit to the dollar.
Complete the memorandum by T-14 and lock the version.
checklist.done: a locked memorandum reconciling to the opinion exhibit exists by T-14.

checklist.step: Run the independent wording and figure review
actions: Review the draft opinion and memorandum as an actuary outside the opinion team: wording against BMA expectations, figures against the tie-out, reliances against the folder.
Record findings on the review checklist and return material items for rework.
Sign the checklist confirming the review and rework completion.
File the signed checklist in the opinion folder.
checklist.done: a signed independent review checklist confirms wording, figures and reliances with rework closed.

checklist.step: Assess adverse development and qualification triggers
actions: Review the year's adverse development, A-vs-E breaches and any reserve strengthening against the qualification criteria in the procedure.
Decide and document whether the opinion is unqualified, qualified or adverse, with the quantified basis.
Brief the CFO and Regulatory Counsel immediately if any outcome other than unqualified is likely.
Record the decision memo in the opinion folder.
checklist.done: a documented qualification decision exists, with early CFO and counsel briefing on any non-clean outcome.

checklist.step: Present opinion conclusions to governance
actions: Present the opinion conclusion, key judgements and uncertainty ranges to the Audit Committee before the statutory statements are approved.
Answer committee challenge and minute directed actions.
Confirm the board pack version of the reserve figures matches the opinion exhibit.
File the tabled material.
checklist.done: the committee has minuted the opinion conclusions before statement approval, on matching figures.

checklist.step: Coordinate with the approved auditor
actions: Share the draft opinion and memorandum with the approved auditor's actuarial team per the audit protocol.
Log auditor challenges and the signer's written resolutions.
Confirm the auditor's reserve range brackets the opined amounts, or escalate the gap to the Chief Actuary and CFO.
Align the opinion date with the audit opinion timeline.
checklist.done: auditor challenges are resolved in writing and the opined amounts sit inside the auditor's range or the gap is escalated.

checklist.step: Sign and date the opinion
actions: Execute the final opinion via DocuSign with the signer's name, credential and approved-status designation on the signature block.
Date the opinion on or after the completion of the underlying valuation work and before the statutory return filing date.
Lock the signed PDF and record its hash in the opinion folder.
Notify the Regulatory Reporting Manager the signed opinion is ready for the return package.
checklist.done: a signed, correctly dated opinion with recorded hash is released to Regulatory Reporting before filing.

checklist.step: Handle post-signature events before filing
actions: Monitor subsequent events between signature and filing: large losses, commutations, reinsurance failures.
Assess whether any event invalidates the opinion; document the assessment even when nil.
Re-issue and re-date the opinion where an event changes the conclusion, and inform the auditor and Regulatory Reporting.
File the subsequent-events note in the opinion folder.
checklist.done: a subsequent-events assessment covers the signature-to-filing window, with re-issue where required.

checklist.step: Deliver the memorandum on BMA request
actions: On any BMA request for the memorandum, log the request and its due date in the regulatory tracker.
Deliver the locked memorandum version within the BMA's stated window, via the channel the request names.
Record what was sent, when and by whom.
Route any follow-up technical questions to the Appointed Actuary with counsel copied.
checklist.done: any BMA memorandum request is fulfilled on time from the locked version with the delivery logged.

checklist.step: Log and remediate opinion-process exceptions
actions: Log every missed milestone, missing reliance, tie-out break or late signature as an exception with impact stated.
Assign root cause and owner; obtain Chief Actuary sign-off on each closure.
Feed recurring causes into next year's opinion-planning meeting agenda.
Keep the log open for inspection by Internal Audit.
checklist.done: all exceptions are logged, owned, closed with sign-off and fed into next year's planning.

checklist.step: Archive the opinion evidence set
actions: File the signed opinion, locked memorandum, tie-out exhibit, reliance folder, review checklist, decision memos and subsequent-events note under opinion/<year>.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Verify retrieval by year and document type.
Record completion in the opinion calendar.
checklist.done: the complete opinion evidence set is archived, labelled and retrievable.

testing.step: Build the population of opinion documents and reliances
actions: Retrieve the year's signed opinion, locked memorandum, tie-out exhibit and the full reliance folder.
List every reliance and limitation stated in the opinion text as the reliance population.
Reconcile the opinion scope items to the statutory statement reserve lines.
testing.done: the opinion document set and a complete reliance population are documented against statement lines.

testing.step: Verify the signer's approval and dating
actions: Inspect the BMA approval evidence for the signer and confirm it covers this insurer and year.
Compare the opinion date to the statutory return submission date — the opinion must pre-date filing.
Verify the signed PDF hash matches the hash recorded at signature.
testing.done: an approved signer, correct date sequence and matching hash are all evidenced.

testing.step: Reconcile opinion figures to the filed statements
actions: Re-tie every figure in the opinion exhibit to the filed statutory statement reserve lines and the signed selection memo to the dollar.
Re-foot the memorandum totals against the opinion exhibit.
Any unexplained difference is an automatic exception.
testing.done: opinion, memorandum and filed statement figures all re-tie to the dollar.

testing.step: Trace every stated reliance to its letter
actions: Match each reliance in the opinion text to a signed certification or reliance letter dated before the opinion date.
Check the certification scope actually covers what the opinion relies on — a ledger certification does not cover case reserves.
List unmatched or under-scoped reliances as exceptions.
testing.done: every stated reliance traces to a pre-dated, correctly scoped signed letter.

testing.step: Re-perform the qualification-trigger assessment
actions: Independently apply the procedure's qualification criteria to the year's adverse development and A-vs-E results.
Compare the independent outcome to the documented qualification decision.
Where the outcomes differ, treat the difference as an exception requiring Chief Actuary review.
testing.done: the qualification decision re-performs to the same outcome or the difference is escalated.

testing.step: Verify the independent review actually happened
actions: Inspect the signed review checklist and confirm the reviewer sat outside the opinion team and performed no drafting.
Trace two material review findings to their rework in the version history.
Confirm the review pre-dates signature.
testing.done: an independent, pre-signature review with reworked findings is evidenced in the version history.

testing.step: Test the governance and auditor coordination trail
actions: Confirm the committee tabling minute pre-dates statement approval and the tabled figures match the opinion exhibit.
Inspect the auditor challenge log and confirm each challenge carries a written resolution.
Verify the opined amounts sit within the auditor's documented range or the escalation is evidenced.
testing.done: governance tabling, auditor resolutions and range positioning are all evidenced.

testing.step: Test the subsequent-events window
actions: Confirm a subsequent-events assessment exists covering signature date to filing date, even if nil.
Cross-check the large-loss log for the window against the assessment's event list.
Where a re-issue occurred, verify the re-dated opinion replaced the original in the filed package.
testing.done: the signature-to-filing window is assessed against the loss log with any re-issue correctly filed.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the document, defect and regulatory exposure.
Assign root cause (reliance gap, tie-out break, dating error, review shortcut) and an owner with a date.
Refer any exception touching the opinion's validity to Regulatory Counsel for a BMA-communication assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and counsel referral where warranted.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the verification
actions: State the conclusion against the signed-before-filing, full-scope and reliance-complete thresholds.
Have the Chief Audit Executive — uninvolved in the opinion's preparation — sign the workpaper.
Report to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper under Bermuda/REG-057/opinion/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to the committee.

checklist.step: Open the filing workflow and confirm the package checklist for the class
actions: Open the annual return workflow for the entity and load the current BMA return instructions for its license class.

Generate the package checklist: statutory financial statements, auditor's report, loss reserve specialist opinion, Declaration of Compliance, and the capital and solvency schedules the class requires.
Diff this year's instructions against last year's and flag new or changed artifacts to the Regulatory Reporting Manager.
Assign an owner and due date to every checklist artifact.
checklist.done: a class-correct checklist with owners and dates exists in the workflow, with instruction changes flagged.

checklist.step: Compute and publish the filing deadline
actions: Compute the deadline as financial year-end plus four months (30 April for 31 December) and record any BMA-granted extension against it.
Publish the deadline and the T-30/T-14/T-7/T-2 alert ladder in the filing workflow.
Circulate the date to the Controller, Appointed Actuary and Corporate Secretary with their artifact due dates.
Log written acknowledgements from each artifact owner.
checklist.done: the computed deadline and alert ladder are published with owner acknowledgements logged.

checklist.step: Receive and version-lock the statutory statements
actions: Receive the board-approved statutory financial statements from the Statutory Reporting Manager.
Verify the director signatures match the board resolution's authorised signatories.
Lock the version in the repository and record its hash on the checklist.
Reject any statement version lacking the approval minute reference.
checklist.done: approved, correctly signed statements are version-locked with hash recorded.

checklist.step: Receive and check the auditor's report
actions: Obtain the signed auditor's report from the Controller and check firm name against the s.16 approval evidence.
Check entity, year and dating — the report must be dated on or before the submission date.
Flag any modification or emphasis of matter to the Regulatory Reporting Manager and Regulatory Counsel before packaging.
Attach the checked report to the workflow checklist.
checklist.done: a checked, correctly dated report from the approved auditor is attached with modifications flagged.

checklist.step: Receive the signed actuarial opinion and verify it matches the statements
actions: Receive the signed loss reserve specialist opinion from the Appointed Actuary and verify its hash against the opinion folder record.
Check the opinion date precedes the planned submission date and the signer designation is stated.
Tie the opinion's reserve amounts to the statement reserve lines to the dollar; return any mismatch to the Appointed Actuary same-day.
Attach the verified opinion to the checklist.
checklist.done: the signed opinion is hash-verified, correctly dated and tied to the statement reserves.

checklist.step: Prepare the Declaration of Compliance for signature
actions: Draft the s.8A Declaration of Compliance stating compliance with the Act's requirements, minimum criteria and solvency margins for the year.

Collect the supporting confirmations behind each declared statement: solvency figures from Capital Management, license conditions from Compliance, governance confirmations from the Corporate Secretary.
Route any known non-compliance to Regulatory Counsel — the declaration must disclose it, not paper over it.
Stage the declaration for signature per the signatory matrix.
checklist.done: a supported declaration is staged, with any non-compliance disclosed on counsel's direction.

checklist.step: Obtain declaration signatures
actions: Route the declaration via DocuSign to the required signatories per the matrix (two directors, or a director and the principal representative, as the instructions require).
Verify each signatory reviewed the supporting confirmations pack before signing — the pack link is embedded in the envelope.
Chase signatures to complete by the T-10 package-complete gate.
File the executed declaration with its certificate of completion.
checklist.done: the declaration is executed by the required signatories before T-10 with the completion certificate filed.

checklist.step: Run the package-complete gate at T-10
actions: Review the workflow checklist: every artifact attached, hash-verified, correctly dated and signed.
Reject the gate if any artifact is missing and escalate the owner to the CFO the same day.
Record the gate decision, date and reviewer in the workflow.
Authorise submission preparation on a passed gate.
checklist.done: the T-10 gate is passed with every artifact verified, or escalated same-day.

checklist.step: Submit the return package to the BMA
actions: Log in to the BMA electronic filing portal with the entity credentials and open the statutory financial return submission for the reporting year.
Upload each artifact to its designated slot — statements, auditor's report, actuarial opinion, Declaration of Compliance and required schedules — and complete the portal declaration fields.
Submit on or before the deadline and save the confirmation receipt with timestamp and reference number.
Record submission date, submitter and receipt reference in the filing workflow.
checklist.done: the portal receipt evidences a complete, on-time submission recorded in the workflow.

checklist.step: Handle portal rejections and resubmissions
actions: On any portal rejection or BMA bounce-back, log the reason and open a tracker issue within one business day.
Fix the artifact with its owner, re-verify hash and dating, and resubmit before the deadline.
Where the fix cannot land before the deadline, escalate to the Regulatory Reporting Manager for an immediate BMA extension or notification call with counsel.
Close the issue with the accepted-submission receipt attached.
checklist.done: every rejection is logged, fixed and resubmitted in time, or escalated for a documented BMA communication.

checklist.step: Trigger the FCR publication clock
actions: On submission, notify the FCR owner that the 14-day publication window under the Public Disclosure Rules has started, stating the exact filing date.
Diarise the publication deadline (filing date plus 14 days) in the filing workflow.
Collect the dated publication capture from the web team before the deadline.
File the capture and day-count with the return evidence.
checklist.done: the FCR publication is evidenced within 14 days of the return filing.

checklist.step: Certify the filing and notify governance
actions: Complete the filing certificate: package contents, deadline computation, gate decision, receipt reference and any rejection history.
Obtain the CFO signature within 5 business days of submission.
Report completion, and any exception, at the next Audit Committee sitting.
File the certificate with the return evidence.
checklist.done: a CFO-signed certificate is filed and the committee informed of completion and exceptions.

checklist.step: Answer BMA queries on the return
actions: Log each BMA query with its due date and assign the drafting owner (Controller for statements, Appointed Actuary for the opinion, Compliance Manager for the declaration).
Route responses touching lateness, corrections or declaration accuracy through Regulatory Counsel before sending.
Send by the BMA's stated date and file the correspondence thread.
Track every query to written closure.
checklist.done: all queries are logged, owner-drafted, counsel-cleared where needed and closed in writing.

checklist.step: Process any post-filing correction
actions: On discovery of an error in a filed artifact, open a correction issue stating the error, its materiality and which artifacts it touches.
Obtain Regulatory Counsel's decision on proactive BMA notification and the correction route.
Re-lock corrected versions, resubmit per the BMA's direction and capture the new receipt.
Record the full correction trail against the original filing.
checklist.done: any correction is materiality-assessed, counsel-routed, resubmitted and fully trailed.

checklist.step: Archive the return filing evidence
actions: File the locked package, executed declaration, receipts, FCR capture, certificate, query threads and any correction trail under statutory-return/<year>.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Verify retrieval by year and artifact type.
Record completion in the compliance calendar.
checklist.done: the complete return evidence set is archived, labelled and retrievable.

testing.step: Build the population of required return artifacts
actions: Export the workflow checklist for the year's return and the current BMA return instructions for the entity's class.
Independently derive the required-artifact list from the instructions and compare to the checklist.
Any required artifact absent from the checklist is a design exception.
testing.done: an independently derived artifact list is reconciled to the workflow checklist.

testing.step: Reconcile the filed package to the locked versions
actions: Retrieve the portal receipt and the filed artifact set.
Compare each filed artifact's hash to the version locked at the T-10 gate.
Any filed artifact differing from its locked version is an automatic exception.
testing.done: every filed artifact hash-matches its gate-locked version.

testing.step: Recompute the deadline and submission timeliness
actions: Recompute year-end plus four months and compare to the receipt timestamp, allowing only a documented BMA extension.
Recompute the FCR day-count: publication date minus filing date must be 14 or fewer.
Show the arithmetic in the workpaper.
testing.done: submission and FCR publication both recompute inside their deadlines or are logged as exceptions.

testing.step: Verify the opinion accompanied the return
actions: Confirm the signed actuarial opinion appears in the filed package slot the instructions designate.
Verify its date precedes submission and its hash matches the opinion folder record.
Re-tie the opinion reserve amounts to the filed statement lines.
testing.done: the filed opinion is present, pre-dated, hash-matched and figure-tied.

testing.step: Test the Declaration of Compliance support
actions: Verify the executed declaration carries the signatories the matrix requires and the DocuSign completion certificate.
Trace two declared statements (solvency margin met, license conditions met) to their supporting confirmations in the pack.
Confirm any known non-compliance in the year was disclosed in the declaration or dispositioned by counsel.
testing.done: signatories, supporting confirmations and non-compliance disclosure all verify.

testing.step: Test the T-10 gate operation
actions: Inspect the gate record: decision, date, reviewer and the checklist state at gate time.
Confirm the gate decision pre-dates submission by at least the procedural margin.
Where the gate failed first time, trace the same-day escalation to the CFO.
testing.done: the gate operated before submission with escalations evidenced.

testing.step: Test rejection and correction handling
actions: List every portal rejection and post-filing correction in the year from the tracker.
Verify each was logged within one business day, fixed with a re-verified artifact, and closed with an accepted receipt.
For corrections, verify the counsel notification decision is documented.
testing.done: all rejections and corrections trace through log, fix, receipt and counsel decision.

testing.step: Verify query handling and certification
actions: Sample 3 BMA queries (or all, if fewer) and verify owner drafting, counsel clearance where required, on-time despatch and written closure.
Confirm the CFO filing certificate was signed within 5 business days of submission.
Confirm committee reporting of completion and exceptions is minuted.
testing.done: sampled queries, the certificate and committee reporting all verify.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the artifact, defect and regulatory exposure.
Assign root cause (checklist gap, version control, late artifact, portal handling) and an owner with a date.
Refer late-filing or declaration-accuracy exceptions to Regulatory Counsel for a BMA-communication assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and counsel referral where warranted.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the verification
actions: State the conclusion against the complete-and-on-time thresholds (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Have the Chief Audit Executive — who assembled and submitted nothing — sign the workpaper.
Report to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper under Bermuda/REG-057/statutory-return/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to the committee.

checklist.step: Source the quarter-end asset data from the investment platform
actions: In Aladdin run the quarter-end holdings and cash-flow report for the Bermuda entity's portfolios: position, market value, rating, duration and projected coupons/maturities.
Reconcile total market value to the custodian statement and the SAP investment balances within the 0.5% tolerance.
Tag each holding with its asset class per the relevant-asset classification table.
Deliver the tagged extract to the ALM / Asset-Liability Actuary with the reconciliation attached.
checklist.done: a tagged, custodian-reconciled asset extract is delivered within tolerance.

checklist.step: Classify relevant assets under the admissibility rules
actions: Apply the reg.11 relevant-asset rules to the tagged extract: include quoted investments, cash and deposits, and admissible receivables; exclude unquoted affiliates, real estate beyond limits and other inadmissible classes per the procedure's classification table.
Document every judgement call on a borderline asset with the rule cite applied.
Compute total relevant assets and record the excluded-asset schedule.
Have the Controller confirm the receivables aging supporting admissible premium balances.
checklist.done: relevant assets are computed with a documented exclusion schedule and confirmed receivables support.

checklist.step: Compute relevant liabilities from the ledger
actions: Extract the quarter-end liability balances from SAP: loss and loss-expense reserves, unearned premium and other insurance liabilities per the relevant-liability definition.
Tie the reserve components to the Appointed Actuary's signed selections for the quarter.
Apply the procedure's exclusions (e.g. liabilities fully secured by admissible offsets) with each exclusion documented.
Deliver the relevant-liability schedule with tie-outs attached.
checklist.done: relevant liabilities are computed, tied to signed selections, with exclusions documented.

checklist.step: Compute the reg.11 minimum liquidity ratio
actions: Compute the ratio: relevant assets divided by relevant liabilities, at the quarter-end date, in the controlled ratio workbook.
Compare against the 75% statutory minimum and the 85% internal early-warning trigger.
Run the workbook's inbuilt checks: foots, cross-foots and prior-quarter movement over 5 points explained.
Sign and date the computation and file it within 10 business days of the data cut.
checklist.done: a signed ratio computation exists within 10 business days, checked and compared to both thresholds.

checklist.step: Escalate trigger breaches immediately
actions: Below the 85% early-warning trigger, notify the Head of Capital Management and Chief Actuary the same day with the driver analysis.
Below the 75% statutory minimum, escalate same-day to the CFO and Regulatory Counsel for the BMA notification decision — reg.11 prohibits dividends and requires rectification while in breach.
Document the remediation plan: asset reallocation, receivable collection or reinsurance settlement acceleration, with owners and dates.
Track the plan to a recomputed compliant ratio.
checklist.done: any trigger event carries a same-day escalation, a dated remediation plan and a recomputed compliant ratio.

checklist.step: Maintain the AAT scenario set
actions: Review the scenario set annually: baseline, interest-rate up and down shocks, catastrophe event, reserve deterioration and reinsurance-recovery delay, each with parameter sources cited.
Calibrate parameters to current market data and the entity's exposure profile from the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager.
Obtain Chief Actuary approval of the set in a dated memo.
Version the approved set in the model governance repository.
checklist.done: an approved, versioned scenario set with cited parameters exists for the year's AAT.

checklist.step: Build the liability cash flows in the projection model
actions: Load the year-end reserve selections into Prophet and derive payout patterns per segment from the reserving triangles.
Project gross and ceded liability cash flows by calendar year, reconciling the undiscounted total to the booked reserves.
Document pattern judgements and any smoothing applied.
Freeze the projection run with its run id and input hashes logged.
checklist.done: a frozen liability projection reconciles to booked reserves with patterns documented.

checklist.step: Build the asset cash flows and run the scenarios
actions: Load the Aladdin asset cash flows into Prophet and align them to the liability projection horizon.
Run every approved scenario, capturing yearly net cash positions, forced-sale amounts and terminal surplus per scenario.
Log each run id, scenario version and input hashes.
Flag any scenario producing a negative cumulative position for remediation analysis.
checklist.done: all approved scenarios are run with logged run ids and failing scenarios flagged.

checklist.step: Analyse failures and management actions
actions: For each flagged scenario, quantify the shortfall timing and size and identify the plausible management actions (asset sales, reinsurance commutation, capital support).
Model each management action's effect and document the assumption that it is executable in the scenario.
Conclude per scenario whether reserves plus assets remain adequate under moderately adverse conditions.
Record conclusions in the AAT findings log.
checklist.done: every flagged scenario has quantified shortfalls, modelled actions and a documented adequacy conclusion.

checklist.step: Peer-review the AAT runs
actions: Re-run one scenario independently from the frozen inputs and compare outputs to the logged run within tolerance.
Challenge pattern judgements, scenario parameters and management-action assumptions on the review checklist.
Return material findings for rework before the report drafts.
Sign the checklist and file it.
checklist.done: a signed peer-review checklist confirms reproducibility and challenged assumptions with rework closed.

checklist.step: Write the annual AAT report
actions: Write the report to the content standard: data, scenario set, methods, results per scenario, management actions, the four quarterly reg.11 ratios and the adequacy conclusion.
Reconcile every quoted figure to the frozen runs and ratio workbooks.
Complete the report by T-21 before the statutory return date and lock the version.
Deliver it to the Chief Actuary, Appointed Actuary and Head of Capital Management.
checklist.done: a locked AAT report reconciling to runs and workbooks is delivered by T-21.

checklist.step: Obtain sign-offs and feed the statutory return
actions: Review and sign the AAT report; the Appointed Actuary confirms consistency with the reserve opinion in writing.
Provide the Regulatory Reporting Manager the signed reg.11 ratio figures for the return schedules.
Confirm the return's liquidity figures match the signed workbooks before submission.
File the sign-off chain with the report.
checklist.done: the signed report and confirmed ratio figures feed the return with the sign-off chain filed.

checklist.step: Report to governance
actions: Present the AAT conclusions, quarterly ratio trend and any trigger events to the Risk Committee before return approval.
Table remediation plans for any early-warning breach with their status.
Minute directed actions and track them in the findings log.
File the tabled pack.
checklist.done: governance has minuted the AAT conclusions and ratio trend before return approval.

checklist.step: Maintain model change control on the projection stack
actions: Keep Prophet models and the ratio workbook registered in the model inventory with versions and validation dates.
Route model and workbook changes through change control with testing evidence before production use.
Track validation findings to closure.
Block AAT runs on unregistered versions.
checklist.done: the projection stack is inventoried, change-controlled and within validation cycle.

checklist.step: Archive the year's AAT and liquidity evidence
actions: File the four ratio workbooks, asset extracts, frozen runs, scenario memo, peer-review checklist, AAT report and sign-offs under aat-liquidity/<year>.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Verify retrieval by quarter and scenario.
Record completion in the valuation calendar.
checklist.done: the complete AAT and liquidity evidence set is archived, labelled and retrievable.

testing.step: Build the population of ratio computations and AAT runs
actions: Retrieve all four quarterly ratio workbooks, the scenario memo, the frozen run log and the AAT report for the year.
List every scenario the memo approves and every run id the log records as the run population.
Reconcile: every approved scenario must have a logged run; unrun scenarios are exceptions.
testing.done: a complete population of workbooks and runs is documented with unrun scenarios flagged.

testing.step: Recompute the reg.11 ratio for every quarter
actions: Independently recompute relevant assets over relevant liabilities from the underlying extracts for all four quarters.
Compare each recomputed ratio to the signed workbook figure within rounding.
Verify each quarter's figure sits at or above 75% and check the return schedule quotes the same figures.
testing.done: all four ratios recompute, match the signed workbooks and the filed return figures.

testing.step: Test relevant-asset admissibility on a sample
actions: Select the 10 largest holdings plus a seeded random 10 from one quarter's tagged extract.
Re-classify each against the reg.11 admissibility table independently and compare to the recorded classification.
Verify the excluded-asset schedule captures every holding the rules exclude — an inadmissible asset counted as relevant is an automatic exception.
Re-tie sampled market values to the custodian statement.
testing.done: sampled classifications re-perform correctly with exclusions complete and values custodian-tied.

testing.step: Test relevant-liability completeness
actions: Re-extract the quarter-end insurance liability balances from SAP and compare to the relevant-liability schedule.
Verify the reserve components tie to the Appointed Actuary's signed selections.
Re-check each documented exclusion against the procedure's rules.
testing.done: relevant liabilities re-extract complete, tied to selections, with valid exclusions.

testing.step: Reproduce a scenario run from frozen inputs
actions: Re-run one approved scenario in Prophet from the logged input hashes and compare outputs to the frozen run within tolerance.
Verify the liability projection's undiscounted total reconciles to booked reserves.
Check the run used the approved scenario version, not a modified one.
testing.done: the sampled scenario reproduces from frozen inputs on the approved version.

testing.step: Verify failure analysis and conclusions
actions: For every flagged scenario, verify the findings log holds quantified shortfalls, modelled management actions and an adequacy conclusion.
Challenge one management action's executability evidence.
Confirm the AAT report's conclusions match the findings log.
testing.done: flagged scenarios carry complete analysis and the report matches the log.

testing.step: Test trigger escalation behaviour
actions: For any quarter below the 85% early-warning trigger, verify same-day notification to the Head of Capital Management and a dated remediation plan.
For any 75% breach, verify same-day CFO and Regulatory Counsel escalation, the BMA notification decision, and that no dividend was declared during the breach.
Where no trigger occurred, document the nil result against each quarter's ratio.
testing.done: trigger events trace to same-day escalation and dividend restraint, or a nil result is documented.

testing.step: Verify peer review and change control
actions: Confirm the peer reviewer built none of the projections and the checklist pre-dates the report lock.
Trace one Prophet model change and one ratio-workbook change through change control with testing evidence.
Check validation dates on the projection stack are within the policy cycle.
testing.done: independent peer review and controlled changes are evidenced across the stack.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the quarter or scenario, defect and solvency exposure.
Assign root cause (classification error, data break, unrun scenario, escalation miss) and an owner with a date.
Refer any exception changing a filed ratio to Regulatory Counsel for a BMA-communication assessment.
Carry open exceptions into next year's verification.
testing.done: every exception is tracked with root cause, owner, date and counsel referral where warranted.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the verification
actions: State the conclusion against the 75%-at-every-date and scenario-completeness thresholds (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective).
Have the Chief Audit Executive — who performed no ALM or ratio work — sign the workpaper.
Report to the Audit and Risk Committees and file the workpaper under Bermuda/REG-057/aat-liquidity/<year>.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to both committees.
